_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Live score band and microstructure stalemate (crowded longs/skew vs fed liquidity) favor staying on the Complacency rung until fear_greed or ETF flows break the coil.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase but intake data does not contradict sideways coil
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d change stays near flat and fear_greed holds 45-55 with momentum near 50
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks below ~40 with dead ETF flows and CVD/exchange inflows confirming breakdown, or fear_greed sustains above ~62 as ETF flows reverse higher
